news.title: Education Minnesota endorses Little, Swanson for Congress
news.summary_en: Education Minnesota has endorsed Matt Little in Minnesota’s 2nd Congressional District and Trina Swanson in the 8th Congressional District.

news.title: Education Minnesota endorses Flanagan for U.S. Senate
